internal_section_headings.heading: A Brief Overview
internal_section_headings.note: Confirmed at fulltext line 88. Spans book pp. 3-5. Chapter-by-chapter preview: Ch.1 (game definition / family resemblance), Ch.2 (presence + immersion critique, four conceptual challenges), Ch.3 (player involvement model + macro/micro phases), Ch.4-9 (six dimensions, each named explicitly), Ch.10 (incorporation), closing paragraph on book's overall contribution.

manifest_heading_verification: CONFIRMED. Manifest's two-heading structure ('(unnamed opening)', 'A Brief Overview') matches fulltext. No additional internal subsection headings present in pp.1-5.
dimension_preview_note: All six dimensions named explicitly in 'A Brief Overview' (book p.4, fulltext lines 129-136) with their italicized one-clause glosses — kinesthetic (control and movement), spatial (exploration and learning of the game's spatial domain), shared (co-presence, collaboration, competition with other agents), narrative (ongoing story + scripted narrative), affective (affect generated during gameplay), ludic (decision making in pursuit of game- and self-assigned goals). This is the volume's only place where all six dimensions are previewed in tight succession in their definitional form.

cross_pipeline_bridge_candidates.rationale: The Introduction announces the PIM + incorporation as the volume's analytical apparatus. Since the dissertation will WIELD PIM as its analytical instrument (per plan §1.2), the Intro is itself the doorway for dissertation adoption. Specifically: the 'subjective distance between player and game environment' framing (lines 63-66) and the 'blending of experiential phenomena' framing (lines 79-82) become candidate dissertation lemmas.

Intro's 'transported our imaginations to the places represented on screen' (lines 20-21) and 'having the chance to inhabit those landscapes, albeit in an abstractly represented simulation' (lines 26-27) are imagistic-cognitive moves that anticipate (without naming) phantasia operations. Forward-points to IG-05 (Spatial) and IG-10 (incorporation as habitation-metaphor).

Intro previews macro/micro temporal-phase distinction (lines 112-115). This is the strongest pre-augmentation bridge to phenomenological time-analysis (per Phase 0 manifest §cross_pipeline_bridge_candidates). Anticipatory only — Calleja's preview here uses no phenomenological vocabulary.

Intro previews affective involvement (line 134) as one of the six dimensions; downstream affective dimension chapter (IG-08) is the primary Gross bridge. Intro's role is only to flag the dimension exists; no anchoring vocabulary yet.

phase2_special_guidance: Standard single-pass (Intro is not a triple-pass unit). REQUIRED elements: (1) capture the chapter-by-chapter preview structure in 'A Brief Overview' as a set of preview/announces edges to IG-01 through IG-10 — this is the spine of Intro edges and should account for ~12-15 of the ≥20 edge target; (2) flag the incorporation-announcement passage (book pp.2-3, fulltext lines 82-87) for cross-link to IG-10 — this is the volume's first occurrence of the word 'incorporation' in its theoretical sense; (3) capture the four-conceptual-challenges forward-pointer (book p.3, fulltext lines 104-106) as an announces edge to IG-02, but do NOT enumerate the four challenges (they are not stated in the Intro — defer to IG-02 metadata + Phase 2 deep); (4) the autobiographical Gzira/Malta vignette (book pp.1-2, fulltext lines 7-46) is a substantive theoretical move (positions the author as first-generation cybernetic native) — capture as a single CONCEPT node ('cybernetic-native standpoint') with one edge to dissertation bridge; (5) preserve the 'incorporation ultimately a metaphor' framing (line 83) — Calleja's metalinguistic self-positioning matters for the Manual Section B incorporation rubric.
notes: Intro reveals NOTHING about the four conceptual challenges of presence/immersion — they are forward-pointed only (Ch.2 will enumerate). Likewise, the six dimensions are NAMED with one-clause glosses (lines 129-136) but not defined; full operational definitions are in IG-03 (Ch.3) and the dimension chapters. The Intro's main load-bearing theoretical move is the announcement of *incorporation* (line 82) as the synthesis term — this is the moment the volume's title-half-2 enters the text. All references to specific games (Kick-Off, GTA IV, Tetris) are illustrative-incidental, not analytic. No figures in Intro (consistent with manifest figure_inventory: zero figures in Ch.1, Intro, Conclusion). Phase 0 manifest's two-heading structure CONFIRMED — no surprises. Phase 0 cite-check absences (zero Burke/Aristotle/Uexkull/Merleau-Ponty/Gibson in volume) translate to empty interlocutor-list AT INTRO LEVEL since Calleja cites no one by name in the Intro at all.
